name: livespec throughput
description: Throughput of non-docs, non-release pull requests across the livespec fleet, one repository per chart: M1 merged green per hour, M2 lead time, M3 stage split. Floor = frozen 7-day baseline, non-docs and non-release, window 2026-11-06..11-13. Defined as code in livespec-dev-tooling ci-runner/observability/boards/livespec-throughput.json and converged by apply-boards.sh; edit the definition, never this board. Deliverer: plan kubernetes-observability; owner: plan throughput-metric (livespec-dev-tooling-oe7cfw).

text_panel.content:
# livespec throughput

**Every panel counts non-docs, non-release pull requests.** A pull request is *docs-only* when every changed path ends in `.md`; a *release* pull request is a release-please one (maintainer direction, 2026-11-14).

**One repository per chart, never stacked or overlaid**, because repositories have different build times. Each chart has its own y-axis. The FLEET is its own line. Low-volume repositories are in tables at the bottom, not in charts.

- **M1 throughput**: merged *green* per hour. Green means the first default-branch `CI` push run at or after the merge head that reached a verdict concluded success. Read it against the repository's 7-day floor, which is stated in the panel name.
- **M2 lead time**: start to merged green, median and p90, never the mean. Start is the first commit's author date (stamped when `git commit` starts, before its gate) for a seat PR, and the dispatch time for a factory PR.
- **M3 stage split**: one repository's median minutes per stage: start to opened, opened to PR CI green, PR CI green to merged, merged to master green.

The headline stays first on [livespec family — all activity](https://ui.honeycomb.io/thewoolleyweb/environments/livespec/board/krThv8DvcwS/livespec-family-all-activity). Defined as code in livespec-dev-tooling `ci-runner/observability/boards/livespec-throughput.json`, converged by `apply-boards.sh`; edit the definition, never the board.
